title: Pilot ratings required for each aircraft type
notes: Synthetic, for the prototype only: not a real program's rules (OD-005). Derived from the synthetic SpareWing data, where each made-up aircraft type is flown by pilots holding the rating named after it (packages/synth/src/sparewing.ts). A real program replaces this file with its own requirements and their source. Extra ratings for one aircraft are entered on that aircraft (SYS-303).
